verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no bulk export feature and no open export formats for leaving Supermemory. The document list/get API is only a developer building block from which an export could be built. Deletion by container tag, self-hosting, and the migration guides (which cover moving into Supermemory) are adjacent capabilities, not data export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
